articles.summary: A Toronto man is facing six charges in connection with what police describe as an “organized street racing” investigation in Peel Region. articles.title: On cusp of merger, ‘Digger bombs for Warner Bros., ‘Verity’ takes No. 1 at box office
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — On the cusp of the studio’s merger with Paramount, Warner Bros.’ “Digger” flopped in its opening weekend, handing Tom Cruise one of the worst debuts of his career and serving as a bitter final note for Warner Bros. as a standalone studio.

articles.title: Police investigate man's death in North York as homicide
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a homicide after a man died in North York on Sunday morning.

articles.title: Man, 31, dead after being struck by vehicle in North York: Toronto police
articles.summary: A 31-year-old man has died after being struck by a driver in a vehicle in North York early Sunday morning, police said.

articles.title: Parrish vs. Crombie: As mayors past and present battle, will the drama drive voters to the polls?
articles.summary: In Mississauga, incumbent Mayor Carolyn Parrish is facing former mayor Bonnie Crombie. With a crowded field and a high-profile showdown at the top of the ticket, the central question hanging over the campaign is whether the drama will actually get residents to the polls.

articles.title: Grocery-style food bank aims to meet rising demand in Durham Region
articles.summary: Food bank visits in Durham Region have surged since the pandemic, according to Feed the Need Durham. The organization is turning to a grocery-style model it says can help make better use of food while giving people more choice. CBC’s Rochelle Raveendran has more.
